pitchDeck.menuDescription: Discover GED+ in commercial demo mode

hero.title: From a passive Data Room to an active LP-relationship driver.
hero.subtitle: InvestHub centralizes, structures, secures and distributes every document tied to investor relations — and measures real engagement to turn the Data Room into a commercial lever.
hero.quote: Stop wondering whether your investors read your reports. Know it.

vision.title: A Data Room built for alternative investments.
vision.body: InvestHub's GED+ is a core platform component: investor communication, regulatory distribution, lifecycle tracking, compliance, LP & partner portal access. Everything is auditable, everything is measurable.
vision.callout: Where a classic DMS only stores documents, GED+ measures, analyses and optimizes the documentary engagement of investors and their contacts.

bullets.0: Spaces → Folders → Documents architecture designed for scale (tens of thousands of documents per fund).
bullets.1: Targeting by fund, segment, structure, subscription and contact group — with inherited funnel logic.
bullets.2: Multi-language, multi-role: LPs, contacts, advisors, distribution partners.
bullets.3: Full audit trail supporting compliance and commercial follow-up.

flow.title: Six orchestrated stages, in one tool.
flow.subtitle: From document sources to engagement piloting, every stage feeds the next without friction.

sources.title: Document sources
sources.body: InvestHub documents or external systems plugged in via connectors.

organize.title: Spaces & Mass upload
organize.body: Spaces, folders, inherited targeting and bulk upload in a single operation.

validation.title: Validation workflow
validation.body: Validation teams, controlled publishing, full traceability.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Multilingual templates, immediate or scheduled sending, targeted reminders.

portals.title: Investor portals

pillars.title: Six pillars to turn the DMS into a piloting tool.

0.title: Business-context architecture
0.body: Dedicated spaces for LP investors, fund reportings, due diligence, partners, multi-fund HNWI — each with its own typology, funds and segments.

1.title: Precise & consistent targeting
1.body: Funds, segments, investors, structures, subscriptions, contact groups. Context is inherited and can never be widened: security by design.

2.title: Native validation workflow
2.body: Activate the workflow per space: assigned validation teams, controlled publishing, notifications sent only after validation.

3.title: Industrial-grade mass import
3.body: Up to 100 documents per session, bulk configuration (folder, targeting, notification, team), automatic session save.

4.title: Tracking & engagement measurement
4.body: Notifications sent and opened, documents viewed and downloaded. Global indicator and rates by investor, contact and advisor.

5.title: Smart follow-up
5.body: Re-engage precisely those who did not open the email or view the document. Customizable templates, CSV export of recipients.

kpis.title: Measured impact for Investor Relations teams.
kpis.subtitle: GED+ becomes an internal IR reporting tool, a commercial prioritization aid, a compliance monitoring tool and a behavioral LP-analysis solution.
kpis.engagement: Document engagement rate visible by space, document and investor.
kpis.massUpload: Time saved on recurring operations: capital calls, reportings, regulatory documents.
kpis.audit: Audit trail on communications: send, delivery, open, click, view, download.
kpis.availability: Documents continuously available on LP, contact and advisor portals.

reasons.overRemainingMany: {{count}} subscriptions exceed their remaining amount while "Limit calls to 100%" is active.

ready.title: No blocking issue
ready.description: The calculation is ready. Nothing is saved before "Create the call".

reasons.availableAfterDueDate: Availability date after the due date

preview.title: Notice preview
preview.description: Simplified preview for the chosen line. Nothing is produced before creation.
preview.combined: This line will be grouped in a combined notice.

fundDetail.title: Fund detail components
fundDetail.intro: Generic components derived from onboarding and created for the fund detail. They only use theme tokens and display server decisions without recomputing them.

sectionNav.title: Section navigation
sectionNav.description: Navigation column between the sections of a page, generalized from "Onboarding sections". The column title is free, each item has an icon, a title, a free subtitle and a right-hand indicator.
sectionNav.variants: Colored "n/N" counter with dot, status dot only, "To complete" badge, no indicator. Optional grouping under subtitles.
sectionNav.states: Rest, hover, active (accent background, primary title), disabled with reason on hover, hidden.
sectionNav.exampleHint: click an item, hover "Distribution" to read the reason; "Secondary market" is hidden

demo.title: Fund sections
demo.distributionDisabled: The partners module is not active on this application.

sectionCard.title: Section card
sectionCard.description: Card for a detail page section, generalized from the onboarding "Identity" card. Validation mode keeps the onboarding behavior; read and edit modes serve the fund settings.
sectionCard.variants: Validation (collapsible header, counters, "Validate the whole section" bar), read (label and value rows, "Edit" button), edit (design system fields, sticky bar). Locked row with reason, row coming from a former application setting.
sectionCard.states: Empty value "Not provided", active (primary outline), unsaved changes, saving (buttons disabled, spinner), "Saved" for 3 seconds, error under the field, "Edit" disabled with reason. Row highlighted after a "Configuration to complete" link.
sectionCard.editHint: click "Edit", clear the name then save to see the error
sectionCard.lockedHint: hover the lock and the "Edit" button

demo.editSummary: Fund name, currency, color and valuation
demo.performanceLegacy: Replaces the application settings "IRR instead of perf" and "No performance display". Chooses the indicator shown on the portal and portfolio for this fund.
demo.editDisabled: You do not have the right to edit this fund.
demo.fromMaster: Received from the master fund. Edit it on the master fund, then propagate.

fundStatusBadge.title: Fund status badge
fundStatusBadge.description: Status computed by the server, read as is by the back office, portals, API and exports. The mockup never derives it from dates.
fundStatusBadge.variants: Draft (neutral, outline), Upcoming (blue, primary color), Fundraising (green), Fundraising ended (yellow), Closed (grey), Archived (dark grey, archive icon). "Suspended" does not exist.
fundStatusBadge.states: Read-only: the badge is not clickable.

pageStateBanner.title: Page state banner
pageStateBanner.description: Banner placed under the header of a detail page to explain why the page behaves differently. Built on Alert.
pageStateBanner.variants: Archived ("Unarchive" action), locked by support (date and reason), mirror fund (link to the master fund), notices being sent (blocked actions), read-only for lack of right.
pageStateBanner.states: Action available, action in progress (button disabled with spinner), action unavailable (disabled, reason on hover).
pageStateBanner.exampleHint: click "Unarchive"; hover the second button to read the reason

demo.noRight: You need the "Archive a fund" right.

effectsPanel.title: "Effects of this action" panel
effectsPanel.description: Lists, before validation, what an action will produce: net asset value, propagation from a master fund, deletion. The list comes from the server.
effectsPanel.variants: Effect with expandable items, effect with a count only, effect without a count. "Reversible" or "Irreversible" marker. Optional effect (checkbox), note under the label, markers hidden in cancellation mode.
effectsPanel.states: List collapsed, list expanded, no effect. Option checked or unchecked (dimmed effect).
effectsPanel.exampleLabel: Example: entering a net asset value

demo.description: Net asset value of 30/09/2026 for share A.
demo.redemptions: Redemptions validated on this date are valued: sale value and final number of shares
demo.subscriptions: Subscriptions awaiting a value are confirmed
demo.emails: Payment confirmation emails sent with certificates
demo.nominal: Share nominal price replaced by this value, the previous price stays in the log

blockersPanel.title: "Blockers" panel
blockersPanel.description: Explains an action refused by the server: blocking items with their count and a link, and a suggested fallback action.
blockersPanel.variants: With or without fallback action, items with or without a link.
blockersPanel.states: Fallback action available, in progress (disabled with spinner), unavailable with reason.

demo.title: This fund cannot be deleted
demo.archiveDescription: The fund will be hidden from portals, nothing will be deleted.

computedSummary.title: Computed summary sentence
computedSummary.description: Highlighted text block that sums up the effect of a configuration in one sentence, for example "Who can subscribe to this share". The sentence is computed by the server.
computedSummary.variants: With label and note, sentence only, custom icon.
computedSummary.states: Update announced to screen readers when the sentence changes.
computedSummary.exampleLabel: Example: who can subscribe to this share

demo.label: Who can subscribe to this share
demo.footnote: Computed from the channels, segments and distributors below.
demo.sentence: This share is open to professional investors, through online subscription and 4 distributors.
demo.closed: This share is closed: no new subscription is possible.

inputs.title: Input fields
inputs.description: Color picker (fund color), day and month picker (liquidity window), compound field frequency then day (valuation, centralization).
inputs.variants: Suggested colors from tokens or free color; day and month without year; daily, weekly (weekday), monthly to semi-annual (day of month), annual (day and month) frequency.
inputs.states: Empty, filled, disabled, error (outline and message under the field).
inputs.exampleHint: the second row of each column shows the disabled or error state

demo.liquidityError: The end date must follow the start date.

statusBadge.title: Status badge
statusBadge.description: Generic badge the fund status badge is built on. New info, outline and strong variants, and optional icon. Optional tooltip for the reason or details.
statusBadge.variants: neutral, outline, info, success, warning, danger, strong; with or without icon.

pageHeader.title: Page header
pageHeader.description: Header of a detail page. Reference: the subscription page. Title followed by the status badge, subtitle made of icon + text items separated by a thin vertical line (PageHeaderSubtitle, PageHeaderSubtitleItem, PageHeaderSubtitleSeparator), actions on the right. The breadcrumb is the application one: the page does not show a second one.
pageHeader.variants: With or without primary action, secondary actions, tertiary menu with icon only or label, destructive entries.
pageHeader.states: Action available, in progress (disabled with spinner), unavailable (disabled, reason on hover; in the menu, reason under the label).

demo.name: Horizon Growth Fund III
demo.publishReason: Complete the configuration before publishing: 3 items missing.

detailTabs.title: Tabs
detailTabs.description: Single tab style across the application (Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger): grey labels, active tab in primary color with a 2 px underline, thin separator line, no background or colored badge. DetailTabsList builds the bar of a detail page: icon, label, neutral counter (TabCount). Place inside a "px-8 bg-card border-b border-border" container.
detailTabs.variants: With or without icon, with or without counter. overflow="truncate" (default) shortens labels, overflow="scroll" keeps them whole and scrolls the bar.
detailTabs.states: Rest, hover, active, keyboard focus, disabled. A tab conditioned by a module or a right is hidden, not disabled.

widgetCard.title: Dashboard widget
widgetCard.description: Summary card with small caps title, subtitle, action and footer. WidgetMetric shows a figure; SegmentedProgress, extracted from onboarding, shows an overall state segmented by color. WidgetMetric can be clickable (onClick, ariaLabel) to open a filtered list.
widgetCard.variants: With icon, action, footer; normal or large value; bar with one or more segments, design system tones.
widgetCard.states: Value filled, value missing ("None"), empty bar.

confirmDialog.title: Confirmation dialog
confirmDialog.description: Confirmation of an action that stays open while processing. The parent closes it on success. Free extra content: warning, effects panel.
confirmDialog.variants: Normal or destructive action, with or without extra content.
confirmDialog.states: Open, processing (buttons disabled, spinner, closing blocked), closed. Confirmation refused by the server: button disabled, reason on hover.

demo.title: Archive Horizon Growth Fund III?
demo.description: Current status: Closed. Subscriptions in progress: 0. Nothing is deleted.

emptyState.title: Empty state
emptyState.description: Empty state of a table or tab. Evolution: generic mode with free title, description and action, on top of the list mode. Translated texts, token colors.
emptyState.variants: List mode (no item, no result with filter reset), generic mode.

richTextEditor.title: Rich text editor
richTextEditor.description: Minimal rich text editor: bold, italic, underline, lists, link. Used by the multilingual portal presentation fields, with one tab per language. The mail template editor keeps its variable pills version.
richTextEditor.variants: With or without language tabs (SegmentedControl above).

dataTable.title: Data table
dataTable.description: Design system table. Evolution: align option per column. On the right, header and cells align and figures become tabular: amounts and percentages, each in its own sortable column. Optional totals row (footer).
dataTable.variants: Sortable or not, left or right alignment, selection can be hidden. Default or compact density.
dataTable.states: Ascending, descending or no sort; row hover; row click.

sparkline.title: History sparkline
sparkline.description: A single series on ChartContainer: no axis or legend, the block title names it. 2 px line on the --chart-1 token, tooltip on hover. The nearby table is the tabular view.
sparkline.variants: Single series, values formatted by the caller.

filterCardGroup.title: Filter card group
filterCardGroup.description: Band of FilterCards above a listing: title with an accent bar, badge, hint and cards in a grid. Replaces the headers copied in the investor and subscription status tabs, SMS history and capital call queues.
filterCardGroup.variants: 4, 5 or 6 columns; with or without badge and hint.
filterCardGroup.states: Active card, inactive card, zero total.

listingTools.title: Listing tools
listingTools.description: ListingColumnsMenu picks the visible columns (the last visible one cannot be hidden); ListingIndicator flags a row specificity with an icon, label on hover. ListingCard also takes a footer (pagination) and DataTable a totals row (footer). FilterBar now handles multi-select and date range filters, and wraps when space runs out.
listingTools.variants: Columns menu with reset; one or more indicators next to the name.
listingTools.states: Hidden column, last column locked, indicator on hover.
listingTools.exampleLabel: Name with indicators and column picker

wizardSteps.title: Wizard steps
wizardSteps.description: Steps of a modal wizard, placed in the BigModalPanelHeader (new area under the title). Number, check once the step is done, current step label in bold.
wizardSteps.states: Done step, current step, upcoming step.

formField.title: Form field
formField.description: Label, asterisk when required, control, hint or error below. labelAside puts a selector to the right of the label. SuffixInput right-aligns a numeric input with its unit.
formField.variants: Required or not, with hint, hidden label (column header), selector next to the label; unit %, currency, currency per unit.
formField.exampleLabel: Required field and field with unit

attachmentRow.title: Attachment
attachmentRow.description: Read-only attachment row: paperclip, name, size, download button. Stack them in a divide-y container.

demoScenarioBar.title: Demo scenario bar
demoScenarioBar.description: Mockup only: picks a scenario above the page header (rights, data, edge cases). Used on the fund detail and the capital calls listing.
demoScenarioBar.variants: With or without an action on the right.

panel.title: Notifications
panel.description: Alerts about the files you review.
panel.emptyDescription: You will be notified here when an answer changes on a file you review.
